subject: Onboarding orchestration: VanguardX implementation cadence & MAP
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@vanguardx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding orchestration: VanguardX implementation cadence & MAP

Hi Ellen —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Attached is a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a draft SOW to get us moving. High-level asks from our side so we can lock calendar commitments and owners:

- Confirm kickoff and weekly operational stand (we proposed 2029-05-20 kickoff).
- Confirm technical point-of-contact who will own API keys, sample dataset access, and infra access (we need that 3 business days before kickoff).
- Procurement: expected SOW redline turnaround (we included procurement@vanguardx.com on case).

Proposed milestone slate (compact view):
- Week 0 (2029-05-20): Kickoff + environment provisioning — Owner: Jordan Blake (Redwood) / Ellen Park (VanguardX)
- Week 1 (2029-05-27): Data ingest & test prompts — Owner: Marissa Cole (CS) / VanguardX engineer
- Week 3 (2029-06-10): Integration review + latency/cost baseline — Owner: Ben Carter (Solutions)
- Week 5 (2029-06-24): Acceptance run + go/no-go decision — Owner: Marissa Cole / VanguardX PM
- +30 days (2029-07-24): Post-go-live health check & success metrics review — Owner: Monica Patel (CS Ops)

Attachments included: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (compact MAP, milestone owners), SOW_draft_v2.pdf (commercial + T&Cs).

Can you confirm the kickoff date and technical contact? If we get a green light this week, Marissa will schedule the kickoff invite and pre-kickoff checklist.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (Excel, 28KB)
Attachment: SOW_draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 72KB)

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@vanguardx.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@vanguardx.com
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 13:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Onboarding orchestration: VanguardX implementation cadence & MAP

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear plan and the MAP. Procurement looped in; they'll aim to return redlines in 5 business days after a short internal review.

Kickoff: 2029-05-22 works better for our internal calendar (we have a product sync on the 20th). Would that break any critical dependency on your side?

Technical contact: Please route API/ingest setup to Marcus Lee (marcus.lee@vanguardx.com), he is our integration lead. He can take the pre-kickoff checklist and has proxy admin rights.

One ask: can we shift the integration review milestone from Week 3 to Week 4 (move from 2029-06-10 to 2029-06-17) — our team has a short sprint the week of Jun 3 that will compress our availability.

If those adjustments are fine, consider this confirmation and we’ll await a kickoff calendar invite.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Head of Product Partnerships | VanguardX
ellen.park@vanguardx.com

----
On Fri, May 10, 2029 at 9:12 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Ellen —
> 
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Attached is a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a draft SOW to get us moving....

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 May 2029 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding orchestration: VanguardX implementation cadence & MAP

Thanks Jordan — I’ll own the delivery lane for VanguardX and will schedule the kickoff for 2029-05-22 per Ellen’s note.

Notes for the kickoff prep I’ll send as a short pre-meeting doc (due 48 hours before kickoff):
- Pre-kick checklist (API keys, sample payload & schema, test user account, expected qps).
- Access matrix: Marcus Lee (integration lead) + 2 engineers; product PM for acceptance criteria; procurement for contract closure.
- Acceptance criteria (pass/fail tests): ingestion success rate >99%, latency P50 < 120ms on their sample workload, end-to-end demo with two production prompts.

I’ve updated the milestone dates to accommodate VanguardX’s request (integration review moved to 2029-06-17). Ben — can you slot a 90-minute integration review on the week of 2029-06-17? I’ll send a poll.

Monica — please prepare the +30 day checklist ownership and monitoring dashboard template; we’ll assign SLOs during kickoff.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: pre-kickoff-checklist.md (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 May 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding orchestration: VanguardX implementation cadence & MAP

All good from solutions — I’ve penciled in 2029-06-18 10:00-11:30 PDT for the integration review (tentative until poll closes).

Quick checklist items I’ll bring to the review:
- Baseline perf test plan + scripts (we’ll need a short corpus and target seq lengths)
- Quantization/instance sizing recommendations for cost targets
- Rollback/fallback plan and expected failover latency

Jordan — I’ll update the MAP tab with Ben’s items and share a single-truth link before kickoff.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
thread_summary: Short sales-to-cs handoff thread confirming kickoff date (moved to 2029-05-22), technical contact assigned (Marcus Lee), integration review pushed one week, MAP and SOW attached, owners assigned for milestones.
